sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com) pages Verbotenes Obst, Curse-Worker's Neighbor and Gordon Agrippa, read through search summaries only (host unreachable): Verbotenes Obst (Forbidden Fruit: a large mass of liquid poison), Violett Schirm (a great curtain of poison that protects), Curse-Worker's Neighbor.
sources.repo_wiki: The fandom spell pages Poison Curse Magic: Aufwachen Dachs (badgers of poison that chew through corpses) and Ultra Giant Bull cached in the repo (.github/wiki).
sources.ja_search: Japanese pages found by search (pixiv encyclopedia, manga-tantei, RENOTE): 寝起きの穴熊(アオフヴァッヘン・ダクス), 毒雲の棲家, 禁じられた果実(ファーボーテン・オープスト), 紫の傘(ヴィオレット・シルム).
sources.design: Order of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs: see docs/magic/character_spells_bulls.md.

spells.name: Poison Curse Magic: Aufwachen Dachs
spells.note: Badgers made of poison. Mode 0 of the Poison book, so it stays in the basic book too.

spells.name: Poison Magic: Violett Schirm
spells.note: A great umbrella of poison; he covered his comrades with it as a defence.

spells.name: Poison Curse Magic: Poison Cloud's Abode
spells.note: NEW page: a cloud of poison that spreads over a wide area.

spells.name: Poison Magic: Verbotenes Obst
spells.note: NEW page: a large mass of liquid poison made between the hands and thrown.

spells.name: Curse-Worker's Neighbor
spells.note: Lets a cursed person control the curse; the poison part of the Ultra Giant Bull. Already locked to his grimoire.

planned.name: Ultra Giant Bull (Compound Magic: Poison, Recombination, Transmutation, Mirror)
planned.note: The page lives in the Recombination book and is in Henry's set; Gordon's part is Curse-Worker's Neighbor.

notes: Not in Gordon's grimoire (kept in the basic Poison book, no source found): Basilisk's Breath (plague nova) and Acid Ball.
